log.title: Demon roster: imps are one species, not the whole faction
log.detail: Imps now only fill the Impaler and Firecaster roles. The other demon ranks are full-sized: Hellguard (shieldbearer), Fiend (swordsman), Archfiend, Hellknight and Blood Witch, plus the Ash Tiller, Brimstone Mason and Hellwarden workers. The extra imp variants are gone. Worker gear for every race is now plain: simple hats, smocks, aprons and kettle helms, with no horns, antennae, wings or crests.

log.title: Builders, farmers and guards for every race
log.detail: Three new posted roles. Builders survey the base around their post and rebuild anything enemies or explosions destroy, using blocks from a nearby chest. Farmers harvest ripe crops, replant, till near water and store the harvest in a chest. Guards hold a post, patrol it and ring an alarm that calls nearby troops. Workers look like plain humanoid working folk in each race's colors, demons included. All four new in-game tests pass in CI.

log.title: Demon player model
log.detail: Player-sized demon skin drawn over any player of the demon race and seen by everyone on the server. Head built from the Oryx reference: spiked cowl blades that flare over the shoulders, a sharpened V jaw, a flat mouthless face and a band of violet eyes. Robe, cloak, forearm brambles and thorns, with bare hands and feet so held weapons sit cleanly.

log.title: Demon wings and flight
log.detail: Demon players take off like an elytra (jump while falling) without wearing one, with a gentle thrust toward where they look and a hunger cost. Wings fold at the elbow: tucked flat down the back on the ground, half-open in a jump, fully spread in flight. The wingbeat has a fast downstroke, slow recovery and wingtip follow-through, and its effort tracks takeoff, climbs and dives. The cloak rides the beat a moment late.

log.title: Imps: Impalers and Firecasters
log.detail: Imps are one species within the demon faction. They fill two roles, the Imp Impaler (studded harness, bone spikes) and the Imp Firecaster (rune mantle, ember orb, fire bolts), on a custom winged, scorpion-tailed model at 0.7× size. Gear is textured, with a glow layer.

log.title: Champions, race unit names and race weapons
log.detail: Every race fields its own named unit for each role, plus a Champion with a signature ability.

log.title: Mana, three new races, five new factions, waves and breaching
log.detail: Mana ore and the Manabloom crop pay for summons. Demons, angels and the hive join the races. Wave campaigns run with a boss bar, and raiders hack through walls.

log.title: Warfront mod and Age of Banners modpack
log.detail: Races, factions, formations, morale, archer volleys, healers, tower defense, plus a curated magic and adventure pack.

log.title: Size and silhouette for every race
log.detail: Unique models per race and role, with some units larger or smaller than others, from upcoming reference images.
